note: The Settlers starter-patch guarantee (SDD-010 §2 step 8, finding 288; plans 22): an Oilfield Days map always holds at least two real accumulations, the way a Factorio map always spawns its starter resources — a basin the charge missed is re-drawn deterministically rather than handed to a player who cannot know it is hopeless. Two, from the sweep's own boards (plans 26 §6): four of its six seeds already carry two or more accumulations and the band leaves them byte-untouched — the boards that win at the shipped purse are among them — while the one-accumulation board and the barren one are re-drawn into real maps. Bound 8: a third of the measured seeds fall below this floor, so eight re-draws leave a residual fault rate well under one in a thousand — loud when it happens, and content-tunable. Ranges identical to the base entry; only viability departs.
